高亮规则修正：高亮在玩家**顶部(白色头)上方1格**。之前玩家顶=row8→高亮row7(蓝点2)✓。现在顶=(7,5)→高亮(6,5)无蓝点，故当前无高亮。
要收集蓝点3(9,8)：需玩家顶到(10,8)，即玩家占rows10-11,col8。
路径：DOWN×3(rows7-8→10-11,col5)，RIGHT×3(col5→8)，然后SPACE。先移动并确认高亮在蓝点3上。

sections.content:
<tool_call>
<function=python>
<parameter=code>
before = current_frame
r = action(['DOWN']*3 + ['RIGHT']*3)
print("result:", {k:r[k] for k in ['action_num','board_changed','level_completed','done','reward','score']})
after = current_frame
print("AFTER nodes (non-bg):")
for n in after.segmentation['nodes']:
    if n['color'] not in ('w',):
        print(n['id'], n['color'], n['pixels'], n['boundary'])
# check highlight (G frame) and player top
W = [n for n in after.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='W'][0]
N = [n for n in after.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='N'][0]
G = [n for n in after.segmentation['nodes'] if n['color']=='G']
print("player W:", W['boundary'], "N:", N['boundary'], "G-highlight:", [g['boundary'] for g in G])
</parameter>
</function>
</tool_call>
